verdict.comment: Several have possibilities but hat-trick seeker KEEP ME STABLE gets the vote ahead of another recent Musselburgh winner Detective.

comments.detective: Overcame trouble with comfortable win at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) latest; respected up 4lb
comments.goldenvalour: On last winning mark but he's struggled this season and needs a major revival
comments.homerstokes: Has claims on his latest Carlisle second and any rain would be a positive
comments.keepmestable: Hat-trick seeker who scored in smooth style last time; big player again back up in trip
comments.penelopessister: Close third over 1m2f here last Monday and she's respected back in trip
comments.traisfluors: Last four wins have been on AW and was well held over C&D last time; others preferred
comments.westillbelieve: Has been up and down this year and his last four wins have been over 1m2f; down the list
comments.zebrastar: Went close over 1m2f here (soft) last Sunday but not in same form at Hamilton on Saturday

races.raceComment: detective is marginally preferred with a score of 56.6%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more progressive over keepmestable. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 6 wins from 36 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: High draws favored in sprints, especially on soft ground

verdict.comment: Most of these have plenty to prove and this could revolve around Beltane and CLASINA, with slight preference for the latter.

comments.arcshadowfax: Struggled over C&D on recent stable debut and is now 0-12 in handicaps; others preferred
comments.balmerino: Still early days and now goes handicapping but he needs a transformation back in trip
comments.beltane: On long losing run but he's a reliable type who has been placed last twice; respected
comments.chiefman: No closer than 10l in six runs for current yard and needs a major revival in new headgear
comments.clasina: 0-15 but she didn't get any luck when favourite at Musselburgh last time; interesting
comments.dandylichious: Record of 1-27 and he's been out of sorts in last four runs; others preferred
comments.lovegames: Inconsistent nine-race maiden and he's not the percentage call; non-runner
comments.nonaynevermind: Well held in all six runs including with form figures of 097 in three handicaps this term
comments.spuntogold: Has dropped a long way in the weights but he's struggled for current yard and is now 1-14

races.raceComment: beltane is marginally preferred with a score of 46.2%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over clasina. Placed in 5 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 25 starts in similar conditions, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: An open handicap. NAOI hasn't lived up to market expectations in her maidens but she brings potential into handicaps.

comments.alltold: 0-5 in maidens and doesn't look obviously progressive ahead of this handicap debut
comments.beautifulaffair: Better at Tipperary (extended 7f) where she had to be switched before running on
comments.dahlianoir: Only 1-8; looks handicapped about right so the jockey's claim is welcomed
comments.edergolesangel: No wins in ten but respected on some flashes of her form, having placed in three handicaps
comments.famedagain: Handicap debut; the fourth at Naas last season suggests this mark should be manageable
comments.faoladh: Fifth last time at Tipperary (1m1f) suggests he might now be high in the weights
comments.farfromdandy: Ran in a rated race last time; previous handicap run at the Curragh was encouraging
comments.greenicon: Dual winner in UK; hasn't kicked on from a fair debut for this yard and now tries headgear

verdict.comment: It's a tough call between four of these but BOBACIOUS gets the vote ahead of Silver Gunn.

comments.bobacious: 2024 C&D win; made all under M Paetel over 1m2f in smallish fields on his last two starts
comments.deborasdream: Brightest spot this term in early May; on a good mark but last season's success came at 1m
comments.hamletsnight: Ex-French maiden; two close seconds this spring but two lesser efforts have followed
comments.justanhour: 2025 record reads 1314 and he ran creditably last time too; should go well again
comments.morcar: Dual C&D winner; good placed efforts on last two starts and probably bang there again
comments.silvergunn: Neck second over C&D in April; failed to fire sole start since; pretty reliable normally
comments.wadacregomez: Although he has a lower turf mark, others in this field may be more solid propositions

races.raceComment: bobacious is confidently preferred with a score of 65.4%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more progressive and more reliable profile over morcar. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 4 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
